what_is_it.heading: Ngokucacileyo ii-STIs
what_is_it.lede: Izifo ezosulela ngokwabelana ngesondo zisuka komnye umntu ziye komnye ngexesha lokwabelana ngesondo - kwilungu lobufazi, impundu, okanye ngomlomo. Zixhaphake kakhulu, kaninzi azinazimpawu, kwaye uninzi lunyangeka lula xa lubanjwe kwangethuba.
paragraphs: Ii-STI zebhaktiriya (i-chlamydia, i-gonorrhoea, i-syphilis, i-trichomoniasis) iyanyangeka ngokusetyenziswa kwee-antibiotics. Ii-STI zentsholongwane (i-herpes, i-HPV, i-HIV, i-hepatitis B) zilawulwa ixesha elide kodwa azinyangeki ngonyango. Nokuba yeyiphi na indlela, ukuvavanywa koko kwenza ukuba unyango lwenzeke.

Uninzi lwe-STIs alunazimpawu zicacileyo - ngakumbi kwabasetyhini. Xa zinganyangwa, zinokubangela ubudlolo, iingxaki zokukhulelwa, kwaye zandise ingozi yokufumana okanye yokudlulisela i-HIV. Ayilophawu lokuziphatha kakubi. Ziyimpawu zobomi besondo obuqhelekileyo kunye novavanyo oluxabisekileyo.

items.headline: Kuthe cwaka rhoqo
items.body: Uninzi lwe-STIs alunazimpawu kwaphela - ngakumbi kwabasetyhini. Uvavanyo kuphela kwendlela ethembekileyo yokwazi.

items.headline: Uvavanyo lwasimahla
items.body: Ikliniki nganye karhulumente ibonelela ngovavanyo kunye nonyango lwasimahla, oluyimfihlo lwe-STI. Akukho kuqeshwa, akukho ncedo lwezonyango.

items.headline: Uninzi luyanyangeka
items.body: I-Chlamydia, i-gonorrhoea, igcushuwa, kunye ne-trichomoniasis zonke zinyangwa ngekhosi emfutshane yamayeza okubulala iintsholongwane okanye inaliti enye.

items.headline: Phathani kunye
items.body: Ukuba une-STI, amaqabane akutshanje nawo afuna unyango - nokuba aziva ephilile. Kungenjalo uya kudlula ngapha nangapha.

pull_quote.text: Uvavanyo lwe-STI yenye yezona zinto zikhathalayo onokuzenza - kuwe, kumntu olala naye, kunye nawo nawaphi na amaqabane exesha elizayo. Isimahla kwaye ithatha imizuzu.

signs.heading: Yintoni onokuthi uyiqaphele - kunye nento ongayi kuyibona
signs.lede: Uninzi lwe-STIs luthe cwaka. Xa iimpawu zivela, ziyahluka ngokuxhomekeke kuluphi usulelo onalo. Iimpawu ezifanayo zinokuthetha izinto ezahlukeneyo - luvavanyo kuphela olunokuxela.

items.title: Ukukhutshwa okungaqhelekanga
items.description: Ukusuka kwilungu lobufazi, kwilungu lobufazi, okanye kwimpundu. Isenokuba namafu, imthubi, iluhlaza, ivumba, okanye yahluke nje kwesiqhelo. Okuqhelekileyo kwi-chlamydia, i-gonorrhoea, i-trichomoniasis.

items.title: Intlungu okanye ukutshisa
items.description: Xa uchama, ngexesha lokwabelana ngesondo, okanye emazantsi esisu. Ngamanye amaxesha kuphazanyiswe usulelo lwe-urinary tract.

items.title: Izilonda, amaqhuma, okanye irhashalala
items.description: Kwilungu langasese, kwimpundu, emlonyeni, okanye ezandleni. Kusenokuba buhlungu okanye kungabi buhlungu. Okuqhelekileyo kwi-herpes, i-syphilis, i-HPV.

items.title: Iimpawu ezingacacanga
items.description: Umqala obuhlungu (igonorrhoea yomlomo), ukudumba kwamadlala, isigulo esifana nomkhuhlane (acute HIV), ukopha okungaqhelekanga phakathi kokuya exesheni (usulelo lomlomo wesibeleko).

spreads.heading: Indlela ezisasazeka ngayo ii-STIs - kwaye azisasazeki njani
yes: Ukwabelana ngesondo kwilungu lobufazi, ezimpundu, okanye ngomlomo ngaphandle kwekhondom
Ukwabelana ngeethoyi zesondo ngaphandle kokucoca okanye ukuzigquma
Ukudibana kwesikhumba ukuya eluswini (HPV, herpes - nkqu nekhondom)
Umama kumntwana ngexesha lokukhulelwa, ukuzalwa, okanye ukuncancisa (ezinye ii-STIs)
Ukudibana kwegazi ukuya egazini (ukwabelana ngeenaliti, utofelo-gazi olungahlolwanga)
no: Ukuwola, ukubamba izandla, okanye ukuncamisa (kuninzi lwe-STIs)
Ukwabelana ngokutya, iziselo, iipleyiti, okanye i-cutlery
Izindlu zangasese, amadama okuqubha, iibhafu, okanye iishawari
Ukuqhagamshelana nje rhoqo emsebenzini, esikolweni, okanye esidlangalaleni

items.fact: Uninzi lwe-STIs alubangeli zimpawu zibonakalayo. Awukwazi ukuxelela ngokujonga umntu - kuquka nawe. Uvavanyo kuphela kwendlela ethembekileyo.

items.myth: Awukwazi ukufumana i-STI ngokwabelana ngesondo ngomlomo.
items.fact: Uninzi lwe-STIs lusasazeka ngesondo lomlomo - i-gonorrhoea, i-chlamydia, i-syphilis, i-herpes, i-HPV. Iikhondom kunye namadama amazinyo anciphisa umngcipheko.

Iikhondom zisebenza kakuhle kakhulu kwii-STIs xa zisetyenziswa ngokuchanekileyo ngalo lonke ixesha. Ii-STIs zesikhumba-to-skin ezifana ne-HPV kunye ne-herpes zisenokusasazeka kwiindawo ezingagqunywanga.
Ungaphinda ufumane i-STI yebhaktiriya efanayo emva konyango. Uvavanyo kwakhona kwiinyanga ezi-3 emva konyango luyacetyiswa kwi-chlamydia kunye ne-gonorrhoea.

prevention.heading: Indlela yokuzikhusela
prevention.lede: Uninzi lwe-STIs luyathinteleka ngemikhwa embalwa elula. Akukho namnye kubo ofuna ukuyeka ngesondo-ukuba nayo ngokuqaphela ngakumbi.

items.title: Iikhondom ngalo lonke ixesha
items.description: Iikhondom zamadoda okanye zabasetyhini, zisetyenziswe ngokuchanekileyo ukusuka ekuqaleni ukuya ekupheleni. Isimahla kuzo zonke iikliniki, kwiikhemesti ezininzi, nakwizikhululo zepetroli.

items.title: Ugonyo lweHPV
items.description: Isimahla e-SA kumantombazana akwiBanga lesi-5 kwaye ngoku ngamakhwenkwe akumaphondo amaninzi. Ikhusela kumhlaza womlomo wesibeleko, iintsumpa zangasese, kunye neminye imihlaza.

items.title: Vavanya phambi kwamaqabane amatsha
items.description: Vavanya ngaphambi kokwabelana ngesondo kunye neqabane elitsha, ngokufanelekileyo kunye. Isimahla, iyakhawuleza, iyimfihlo. Iikliniki ezininzi zinika iziphumo kwi-HIV imizuzu eli-15.

items.title: I-PrEP ye-HIV
items.description: Ipilisi yemihla ngemihla ethintela i-HIV. Zisimahla kwiikliniki. Iluncedo kubantu abasengozini ephezulu - amaqabane amatsha rhoqo, amaqabane ane-HIV, abathengisi ngemizimba.

items.title: Zivavanye
items.description: Ngena kuyo nayiphi na ikliniki karhulumente. Cela isikrini esipheleleyo se-STI - i-HIV, igcushuwa, i-gonorrhoea, i-chlamydia. Uninzi lweziphumo phakathi kwemizuzu ukuya kwiintsuku.

items.title: Ukuba unayo - qala unyango kwangolo suku
items.description: Ii-STI zebhaktiriya zidla ngokunyangwa ngekhosi emfutshane yamayeza okubulala iintsholongwane okanye ngenaliti enye. Thatha yonke into njengoko kuchaziwe.

items.title: Xelela amaqabane akho akutshanje
items.description: Nabani na okhe wabelana ngesondo naye kwiinyanga ezi-6 ezidlulileyo kufuneka avavanywe. Ikliniki ingakunceda ukuba ubaxelele ungaziwa ukuba bayafuneka.

items.title: Akukho ngesondo ngelixa uphathwa
items.description: Linda de iklinikhi ithi ucacelwe. Kungenjalo uya kuphinda uyidlulisele kwiqabane obusanda kuliphatha.

items.title: Phinda uvavanye kwiinyanga ezi-3
items.description: Ii-STI zebhaktiriya zinokubuya ukuba iqabane khange linyangwe. Uvavanyo olulandelayo luqinisekisa ukuba usulelo luphelile.

get_help.heading: Masiye phi
get_help.lede: Uvavanyo lwe-STI lusimahla, luyakhawuleza, kwaye luyimfihlo kuzo zonke iikliniki zikarhulumente. Akukho ncedo lwezonyango, akukho sigwebo, akukho mibuzo ongafuni kuyiphendula.

helplines.name: Umnxeba woNcedo lweSizwe ngoGawulayo
helplines.description: Ii-STI kunye neengcebiso eziyimfihlo kunye nokudluliselwa

helplines.name: Fumana eyona kliniki ikufutshane nawe
helplines.description: Ikliniki nganye karhulumente ibonelela ngovavanyo kunye nonyango lwasimahla lwe-STI
helplines.meta: Akukho kuqeshwa · akukho ncedo lwezonyango olufunekayo
